summary: User's in-app pass over MPI-445 and MPI-439 found two regressions. Reset was a DEAD BUTTON on both Adjust destinations - MPI-436 deleted resetBtn.on('click', _reset) while rewriting that block for two destinations, and nothing failed because the button still mounted and destroyed cleanly. And mask to paint painted the module default because PaintManager.color is panel state, only set when a paint-family panel mounts, so reaching the context menu from a mask tool never had the user's colour. Both fixed and clicked in Chromium. The third report, Apply, does NOT reproduce at manager, panel or end-to-end level and stays open on one question to the user.

USER-VALIDATED in the app 2026-08-05. Reset works on both destinations and the conversion takes the picker's colour. Apply also works on the restarted build - the theory in the brief was right, a dead Reset made Apply's own feedback read as nothing happening, so no Apply change was needed and none was made. The follow-up report, that converted paint looks washed out, is NOT an opacity bug: the conversion is a copy and the mask draws OVER the paint, so the new colour is seen through a 70 percent white overlay - red c41c24 at 93 percent under it computes to the pale pink in the screenshot. Toast now says the mask is kept on top.
Archived out of board.columns.done to .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/_archived/MPI-447/ (workspace preserved intact). mpi-archive run 2026-08-21.
